acceptance.mechanism: Injected AppleScript return values, actual native handoff adapter and actual fixed proof controller with all subprocess/network APIs denied

acceptedInvariants: Cleanup close and absence scripts fence a stopped Chrome application before invoking it; the query is existence-only for exact retained positive IDs. This is a source-level fence test, not a physical stopped-Chrome experiment.

One close command is admitted. Only a failed/unconfirmed command admits one separate exact saved-window/tab existence query; confirmed command makes no extra query. Cached known receipt cannot repeat effects.

Original window absent can establish only scoped_window_absence_observed, with unknown command cause and globalTabDestructionConfirmed:false. A missing tab in a present saved window remains uncertain.
Present target, malformed/failed read and mismatched identities preserve uncertainty without printing command output, URL, content or private stderr.
Receipt schema rejects unsupported fields, contradictory provenance and global-destruction claims. Bare historical receipt is accepted only when explicitly labelled legacy offline.

Direct and guard concurrency cannot repeat close/read. Guard durably reserves before effect, refuses malformed/foreign receipts and cannot refill authority after pre-effect journal failure or lost final acknowledgement.
A lost final acknowledgement leaves the proof poisoned and blocks all further advancement/replay; observed in-memory closure is not relabelled a durable final journal acknowledgement.

preservedReturn.failure: Close script invoked tell application without a pre-tell stopped-application fence, although the read script already had that fence.
preservedReturn.repair: One precondition before the existing close script tell; no changes to open, presence query or application runtime.

limits: Synthetic adapter/controller acceptance only. No real browser/application execution, Google request, consent, event, deployment or actual cleanup effect was performed by independent QA.
Does not prove agent-caused closure or destruction of a moved tab. It records direct command confirmation or original-window absence with distinct provenance.
Does not erase the original v7 late close607.421seconds, later absence observation, nativeClosed:false/closed:false guard exception, or failed consent outcome. Closed allowances remain closed.
The repair does not provide a watchdog or retrospectively satisfy the original600second window. Root owns prompt bounded cleanup and any separately scoped actual blank-window check.
